title: Thai Beef Stew
description: A Thai-inspired beef stew made with tender beef, vegetables, and a flavorful sauce. Perfect for a cold winter's night.

ingredients.name: beef
ingredients.notes: sirloin or ribeye, cut into 2-inch pieces

instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the onions and bell peppers to the pot and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the curry paste to the pot and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the beef broth, fish sauce, brown sugar, and coconut milk to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 hour.
Add the beef back to the pot and cook until tender, about 30 minutes.
Season with hot sauce to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
